title: Consumer-Scale Chat Service
subtitle: Build durable conversations and responsive streams while controlling user isolation, admission and token cost.
author: By Sourav Banerjee

practice_prompts.label: Clarify the product
practice_prompts.hint: Ask the six questions and state the assumptions you will design to.

practice_prompts.label: Size it aloud
practice_prompts.hint: Go from daily users to messages, tokens, open streams and replicas.

practice_prompts.label: Trace one turn
practice_prompts.hint: Admit, assemble, stream, persist, and name the three boundaries.

practice_prompts.label: Disconnects, overload and failover
practice_prompts.hint: What stops, what survives, who gets shed and what degrades.

practice_prompts.label: Metrics, release gate and cost pivot
practice_prompts.hint: Tie each choice to a metric; answer 'the bill grows faster than users'.

rubric: Derives about 280,000 open streams from 100M DAU with Little's Law and labels every figure an assumption.
Separates durable full history from the bounded prompt and names the summariser's dropped-detail risk.
Propagates Stop and disconnect cancellation to inference and tools, and keeps the persisted partial answer.
Takes user_id from authentication at every store, memory and retrieval boundary.
Distinguishes per-user token-bucket admission from per-tier fair scheduling, and gateway 429s from capacity 429s.
Keeps the prompt prefix byte-stable and weighs a model cascade against the cache it forfeits.
Describes cold regional failover that respects residency and sheds the free tier first.
Proves the design with first-token time, abandonment, isolation tests and cost per successful conversation.

editorial_review.evidence: Compared all 46 captured sections against the earlier draft paragraph by paragraph. The draft dropped the Sam free-tier trace, the admit/assemble/stream/persist rule, the 70M-input-tokens-justify-caching point, the tools-system-messages cache order, both source two-minute answers, the eight carry-the-round lines, the sixty-minute table, 429 short/long-term responses, abuse limits, the stage-decomposition trace, the Claude-variant section (one line) and the reference annotations; all are restored. Split the overloaded step 7 into admission, moderation and regions deep dives plus a new Claude-variant dive with a degradation ladder built only from source rules. Fixed a broken sizing-table cell, an empty cost-card header, a paraphrased mission quote and a dead 'section 12' pointer; replaced one generic caption shared by three figures with captions read from each SVG and moved the upload figure beside the file pipeline. Follow-ups became answer reveals (21 total). Added material is labelled: the EventSource GET-only note and the durability vs async-replication reconciliation. Source inconsistencies resolved in text (2026-11-16): durability row 'a sent message is never lost' vs asynchronous replication to a second region (step 7 and the deep dive) → durability is stated for acknowledged writes in the home region, with a recovery-point objective bounding what a whole-region loss can drop, because the source's regional design, its failure notes and its 'slightly stale history' line all assume async replication; the reconciliation-note wording is removed. November 20 complete maintained-baseline review: Complete maintained casebook: brief, Sam trace, eight walkthrough steps, four figures, sizing table, all deep dives (prefix, routing, admission, moderation, regions, Claude wording, references), every practice and follow-up answer, delivery plan, calibration, cost card and Quick review.
